notes.summary: Reconstructed full-affine above approximation with arbitrary exact finite rational interpolation, actual real recession, rational spatial graph faces and genuine finite scalar-extension membership.
notes.detailedSummary: For full-domain continuous convex f bounded relative to finite rational-carrier convex real gamma, the conjugate has precisely the actual compact real polytope Delta as domain and is continuous on its entire boundary. Compact dual sampling gives an above approximation generated by rational spatial samples and actual lifted recession rays. It has global error eta, exact requested rational sample values, exact actual recession and a finite rational carrier despite real heights. Separation, polyhedral generation/projection and compatibility-kernel arguments are explicitly reconstructed.
notes.text:
On one complete rational affine page Q choose a rational origin. A finite-carrier convex gamma is max_j(p_j(x)+a_j): each affine piece on an interior full-dimensional cell is globally supporting by segment convexity; density/continuity supplies boundaries. Its actual recession is h=sigma_Delta with Delta=conv{p_j}, which may have irrational vertices. The finite intercepts give |gamma-h| bounded. Positive h in every nonzero direction implies 0 is interior to Delta by separation. For continuous convex f bounded relative to gamma, |f-h|<=B for some B. Thus phi=f* is finite and bounded on Delta, and infinite outside: inside, p(x)<=h(x); outside, a separating ray makes p(tv)-f(tv) diverge. Phi is convex and lower semicontinuous.

The required whole-boundary continuity is proved, not assumed. A finite LSC convex function on a compact polytope is bounded above by its largest vertex value M and bounded below by compactness. At p choose radius r below every inactive inequality's slack divided by its linear-part norm. If feasible y tends to p, z=p+r(y-p)/|y-p| is feasible: active inequalities hold along that ray and inactive ones hold by the radius. Convexity yields phi(y)<=(1-|y-p|/r)phi(p)+(|y-p|/r)M. LSC gives the other limit. This covers every face, also in a lower-dimensional affine hull. Epigraph separation proves double conjugation: for a point directly below the graph, a strict separator cannot have zero height coefficient since the epigraph contains a point over that same spatial coordinate. Divide the positive coefficient to obtain an affine minorant. Outside a compact closed domain, spatial separation and scaling give infinity. Hence f=phi* and f(x+v)<=f(x)+h(v).

Finite rational carrying-cell recession cones cover Q: an unbounded sequence on any ray occupies one fixed cell, and dividing that cell's rational inequalities proves the direction belongs to its recession cone. On each such cone h is the actual cell linear part. Finite rational generators r of these cones therefore give epi(h)=cone{(r,h(r)),(0,1)} exactly, with rational spatial components but real heights. Finite generation is justified by removing rational lineality, sectioning a pointed cone with a strictly positive sum of defining forms, and active-face induction on its compact section; homogenization gives inhomogeneous vertices/rays. Finite cones are closed by reducing nonnegative representations to independent column subsets. Projection is finite elimination of lower and upper variable bounds; rational coefficients remain rational.

Since f is continuous, phi(p)=sup_{x rational}(p(x)-f(x)). For each p choose a rational sample within eta/2. Whole-boundary continuity gives a neighborhood with error <eta; compactness supplies finitely many samples A. Append any specified finite rational B. Then phi-eta<=phi_A<=phi on Delta, where phi_A=max_{a in A}(p(a)-f(a)). Let E_A=conv{(a,f(a)):a in A}+epi(h). A compact hull plus this closed cone is closed, projects onto all Q, and lies in epi(f), by convexity and the recession inequality. Its attained finite lower boundary a has conjugate phi_A on Delta and infinity outside, by direct maximization over generators. Double conjugation gives GLOBAL f<=a<=f+eta. Every retained sample has equality because E_A contains its lifted graph point and a>=f. Bounded global error, or division along recession rays of E_A, proves exact h.

Spatial rationality is not inferred from an irrational dual subdivision. Each lower graph face is the hull of a subset of rational spatial samples plus the cone of a subset of rational spatial rays, with their actual real lifted heights. The vertical ray is excluded by its nonvertical supporting functional. Projection is injective on that graph face; the projected face is rational. There are finitely many such faces; projected intersections are common faces because the lower boundary is single-valued, and full-domain supports cover the whole graph. Thus the carrier is finite and rational. On this carrier shared-face affine compatibility is a finite rational linear system. Its real kernel has a rational basis; scaling basis vectors clears slope denominators on saturated cell lattices and leaves rational constants. The function is consequently a finite real linear combination of ordinary PA functions on one rational carrier. For primitive positivity, subtract an ordinary convex support at a face-relative-interior point. The affine difference vanishes tangentially there, so the tangent correction is zero and every inward slope is nonnegative. Every nonnegative local cycle therefore has nonnegative divisor. No real slope is rounded and no irrational maximum wall is admitted.

P05.1-paper.tex Sections 2-4 and argument.md contain these proofs. The own finite check has 1,089 dual and 4,225 primal grid points plus one symbolic irrational-height/rational-break example; these are only finite diagnostic observations, not this continuum proof. Rerun python3 exact_checks.py with exact-check-input.json.

notes.summary: Proved one-subspace exact changed continuous trace lemma via compact minimizing fibers and dual epigraph lowering; intermediate F is continuous convex, not presumed PA.
notes.detailedSummary: For restriction T and actual dual Delta, k=min_fiber phi is attained, closed convex and continuous on the WHOLE image polytope, and equals the trace conjugate. If trace g is raised by at most eta with actual restricted recession, b=g* lies between k-eta and k. The minimizing graph S is compact, and conv(graph phi union S)+vertical-up has lower boundary psi with phi-eta<=psi<=phi, psi>=b composed with T and exact fiber minima b. Hence F=psi* has global f<=F<=f+eta, exact whole trace g and unchanged actual recession. No simultaneous distinct-overlap assertion or premature MA.
notes.text:
Let H be ONE rational affine subspace of a complete page Q; translate a rational origin in H. Use n2's actual compact dual Delta and continuous phi=f*. Let T:Q*->H* be restriction and Delta_H=T Delta. For each q define k(q)=min_{p in Delta,Tp=q}phi(p). Fibers are nonempty compact and the minimum is attained. Convex combinations of minimizers prove convexity. For q_j->q choose minimizing p_j and a compact subsequence along the liminf; LSC gives k(q)<=liminf k(q_j). The extended domain is closed and k is bounded finite there. Delta_H is the hull of projected vertices, a compact polytope; n2's full-boundary argument proves continuity on all of it. Grouping the dual supremum by fibers gives k*(x)=f(x) for x in H. Closed-convex double conjugation yields k=(f restricted to H)*, and h_H=h restricted to H=sigma_Delta_H.

Suppose f_H<=g<=f_H+eta with g finite continuous convex and actual recession h_H. Its conjugate b is continuous on the WHOLE Delta_H, with k-eta<=b<=k and that exact domain, by n2. The set M={p in Delta:phi(p)=k(Tp)} is closed because both functions are continuous on their whole domains. S={(p,b(Tp)):p in M} is therefore compact. It contains a lifted minimizer of EVERY fiber, including all boundary fibers.

Define E=conv(graph(phi) union S)+R_{≥0}(0,1). The convex hull is compact: affine dependence reduces combinations to at most dim(Q)+2 points, so it is an image of a compact finite product times a simplex. A convergent sum with this compact hull cannot have an unbounded vertical parameter, proving E closed. It projects precisely to Delta and has bounded-below attained vertical fibers, so its lower boundary psi is finite closed convex on Delta. Every source is above phi-eta (on S use phi=k composed with T), and convexity of that function yields psi>=phi-eta. Graph(phi) is present, so psi<=phi. Every source is above b composed with T: graph(phi)>=k composed with T>=b composed with T, while S has equality. Convexity yields psi>=b composed with T. For every q a minimizing p in M supplies (p,b(q)) in E; hence min_{Tp=q}psi(p)=b(q) EXACTLY, with attainment.

Take F=psi*. Compact domain and bounded psi give a finite globally Lipschitz convex F. Order reversal gives f<=F<=f+eta everywhere on Q. Grouping its supremum by fibers gives F_H=b*=g at every point of H. Its recession is sigma_Delta=h, because the bounded dual height contributes zero after scaling. This proves controlled global extension with an exact changed continuous trace. It does not claim F is PA, assign MA to F, or claim distinct restriction constraints can be imposed simultaneously; their lowering operations can interfere.

The complete proof is P05.1-paper.tex Section 5, argument.md, and proof-source-coverage.md. The finite check in exact-check-output.txt uses phi(p1,p2)=|p2| on [-1,1]^2, b=-1/4 and psi=(5/4)|p2|-1/4, with explicit convex source combinations. It illustrates, but does not replace, the continuum proof. Rerun python3 exact_checks.py.

notes.summary: Exact whole-H genuine PA synchronization, all-face book PC/support positivity and global decreasing real regularization proved for independent normal quotients.
notes.detailedSummary: A pointed rational carrying refinement of the PA trace supplies ALL spatial vertices and exact lifted recession rays. Appending those vertices to n2’s above approximation of n3’s F forces epi(g) containment, and the above inequality forces equality on all unbounded H with global error <=2eta. notes.text:
First let the raised trace g in n3 be finite rational-carrier real PA. Refine its carrier by a rational coordinate arrangement so each cell is pointed. Finite rational spatial vertices and rays generate each cell. Since g is affine on it, its graph points are convex combinations of lifted spatial vertices plus actual lifted recession rays (r,h_H(r)); the vertical ray fills its epigraph. Convexity supplies the reverse inclusion. Thus epi(g)=conv{(v,g(v)):ALL vertices v}+epi(h_H). Apply n2's above-primal approximation to n3's intermediate F with error eta, appending every trace vertex v as a rational sample. Its new epi(F_A) contains (v,g(v)), and epi(h) intersected with H times R is exactly epi(h_H). Therefore it contains the ENTIRE epi(g), including every unbounded trace ray. This gives F_A on H<=g, whereas F_A>=F and F on H=g give the opposite inequality. Hence whole-H equality is exact, with GLOBAL f<=F_A<=f+2eta, exact actual recession, rational spatial graph geometry and finite scalar-extension membership. Finite-point matching alone is not the argument.

For book PC equivalence, any convex cell inside a finite union of pages lies in one page: otherwise its relative interior would be covered by finitely many proper affine subspaces, impossible by the nonzero product-of-linear-forms polynomial argument. Refine the inherited rational complex by page/H equations, making H faces. Inside cells, rational Jensen extends by continuity. A rational endpoint segment in a page has finitely many rational break parameters. At a break its adjacent cells share an inherited face; opposite nearby rational points give a legal midpoint PCC. These midpoint inequalities order left and right limiting secant slopes. Cellwise convexity then orders all secants across each break, proving convexity on the whole segment. Lower-dimensional faces use the induced one-dimensional cells. Rational approximation and continuity give convexity on the whole complete page; agreement on H is single-valuedness. No coarser box carrier is substituted.

Conversely, for ANY legal real-endpoint PCC centered outside H, all incident cells lie in its unique page and Jensen applies. At a center in H group endpoints by page, with total weights A_i>0 and group barycenters y_i. The quotient barycenter equation sum A_i[y_i]=0 and independence force every y_i into H. Page Jensen and then convexity of the shared trace prove the PCC. Endpoints in H can be assigned arbitrarily and zero groups discarded. This covers every face and rational refinement, with real endpoints and weights; no generic normal-circuit assumption is used.

For genuine positivity, let q support the common trace at x in H. The restriction-dual identity from n3 gives an attained minimizer p_i of each page conjugate over q. Equality g(x)+g*(q)=q(x) becomes a_i(x)+a_i*(p_i)=p_i(x), so p_i is a page support lifting q. They agree on H and independent quotient tangents combine them into one ambient support; extend over an ambient complement. Outside H use a local unique-page support. At a face relative interior point, subtract this support in the primitive formula of n1. The affine difference vanishes tangentially on the face, so the tangent correction vanishes; each inward derivative is nonnegative. Multiplication by every nonnegative balanced local cycle weight proves divisor positivity in every dimension on every rational refinement, including zero weights. The granted signed balance/refinement chain then gives nonnegative raw iterates. Complete page cycles themselves balance by opposite saturated quotient normals with equal actual real c_i.

Finite rational ambient hyperplane arrangements extending every page's rational spatial walls and H equations yield common restrictions along all of H. Their union is a finite rational complex because pages meet only in H and share its subdivided faces. No real height creates an extra spatial wall.

For arbitrary continuous printed-PC f bounded relative to ACTUAL gamma, first obtain convex page/trace restrictions as above. On H use n2 with actual gamma restricted to H to choose ONE common g_n above f_H with error eta_n=2^{-n} and exact h_H. Extend each page with the preceding sync using this same g_n, obtaining a_n with whole trace equality and GLOBAL error [0,2eta_n]. Glue rational carriers and use the all-cycle positivity argument. Define G_n=a_n+4eta_n. Then everywhere 4eta_n<=G_n-f<=6eta_n and G_{n+1}-f<=6eta_{n+1}=3eta_n<4eta_n. Thus G_n strictly decreases globally to f uniformly, with gap at least eta_n. The shift is rational, changes no divisor or recession, and the bound is against the unchanged actual gamma. Coupled continuous/non-PA/nonseparable traces are allowed. The full proof is P05.1-paper.tex Sections 6-9 and argument.md. exact-check-output.txt checks one three-page grouping and 12 shift intervals; rerun python3 exact_checks.py.

notes.text:
All hypotheses of R230 in n1 hold for this book: finite rational closed support, actual strictly positive balanced cycle, continuous finite actual real PC gamma and positive recession. For every u in C_b it gives actual unrestricted continuous real-endpoint PC f=P_gamma(u), with |f-gamma|<=||u||. Apply n4 to this very f. It is in the genuine finite rational-carrier real PA closure, with exact branch recession, BEFORE assigning MA. This proves the all-obstacle regularization consequence, not just finite obstacle roofs.

Now the S262/S272 mixed completion premise in n1 applies to the genuine domain. It gives positive finite Radon outputs of raw mass M=deg(gamma), symmetry, locality and agreement with the signed primitive recursion. On each fixed relative-bound C family the exact bound is integral H0 MA <=(2d/epsilon)C deg(gamma)+J0, and tails <=that bound/T. Genuine PA cutoff telescoping produces 2CM at each of d steps and division by epsilon, not a missing factor. Passing compact nonnegative height tests preserves the exact fixed C. Compact-test estimates and test approximation yield global vague uniformity. Uniformly convergent families have one finite relative bound, so truncating C_b tests yields ordinary weak convergence and continuity, including nets. Fixed-C tails make weak and BL uniformity valid on those families only, not on the entire domain. Zero raw mass yields the zero output by positivity. No raw operator is assigned to excluded literal endpoints.

For at least two pages choose rational v in H. The positive complete plane c1[V1] is a balanced subcycle; residual sum_{i!=1}c_i[V_i] is explicitly effective balanced on every rational refinement. Choose rational nonzero a in V2 outside V1; L=Ra is transverse to V1 and has both signs. A saturated lattice basis of V1 has dual coordinate forms ell_1,...,ell_d that extend rationally to the ambient space and annihilate L. The ambient convex rational jet J=sum|ell_j| is genuine PC on its rational hyperplane fan, and the midpoint between a and -a is an exact flat rational relation. Include v and all specified rational fan walls in any chosen tangent refinement. On V1 a single absolute coordinate cuts twice the saturated coordinate kernel. Repeated coordinates restrict to zero; all d distinct coordinates produce 2^d at the origin. Multilinearity contributes the d! permutations, so the raw atom is c1 2^d d!, not an appended normalization. Every successive divisor on the effective residual is nonnegative, so m0(J)>=c1 2^d d!>0 on the actual book.

The S272 actual-reference rational-jet premise applies to precisely this jet, rational point, specified finite rational tangent refinement and actual real positive-growth gamma. Its construction is important: on the compatible fixed rational carrier the all-face PC cone is rational polyhedral. Perspective endpoint variables and rational finite generation give its finite inequalities, including every face rather than generic circuits. Work in the actual coefficient point's active rational face. A small rational simplex around it, inside the PC/positive-growth neighborhood, gives EXACT gamma=sum t_j gamma_j, t_j>0, sum t_j=1, with rational PC positive-growth references. For a common rational norm rho, slower rational alpha, and common rational C, max(gamma_j,C+alpha rho) has rational walls, a common cone near v, and original reference outside compact sets. Insert max with C+t+delta J inside a common rational radius, choosing delta A<=alpha/2 and t<alpha r/4. An unchanged collar glues the entries; all summands have the same germ. The real convex sum F=sum t_j G_j therefore has EXACT germ C+t+delta J, is genuine finite rational-carrier real PA PC, and differs boundedly from ACTUAL gamma. The unrelated gamma' remainder is not added at the flat point. Its raw atom is delta^d m0(J)>0 by d recursion steps, and flatness is preserved on every specified rational refinement.

Choose rational R small enough that its closed norm ball lies in the affine-star germ and contains no other carrier vertex. Set B_R=(R-rho(x-v))_+ and u=F-gamma+B_R. This is genuine bounded real PA. For ANY raw printed-PC competitor q<=F+B_R, rational boundary points v+/-Ra/rho(a) give q(v)<=F(v) by flat midpoint Jensen. Each rational interior point lies on a rational chord from v to its boundary point in the same affine cell, so affinity/Jensen gives q<=F. Outside the bump the obstacle is F. For a real center, shrinking rational simplices in its relative rational face give the same bound using the printed allowance for real barycentric weights and continuity of F, never continuity of q. Since F itself is a competitor, the actual unrestricted envelope and its usc version equal F. It is already a genuine finite PA endpoint. Only v has raw top mass in the bump; artificial refinement vertices have zero mass. Its gap is -R, hence the contact integral equals -R delta^d m0(J)<0. No changed reference, unsigned intermediate rule or appended factorial is used.
